summary: The change does what was asked: it redoes job h49d. The producer prompt now says to run targeted tests while working, that Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite, and that the producer runs the full suite at most once. In run.rs, the full-suite gating and its send-back are removed, along with FULL_TEST_COMMAND, ran_full_tests, enforce_tests and tests_missing. The send-back for unmet acceptance criteria stays, and the gaps note no longer tells the verifier to run the suite. Athena's own checks on the candidate, the verdict logic and the verifier prompt are unchanged. D113 is added with the requested figures, and D95 and D103 get forward pointers. The old CHANGELOG D95 entry is kept with a supersession note, and athena-v0.md is updated. I ran the lifecycle tests (61 passed) and the job_plan tests (23 passed); clippy -D warnings and fmt --check were both clean. All changed files are on the deliverables list, and I found no blocker or major problem.
